components.css: :host{--cyc-black:#050508;--cobalt:#0A33FF;--cobalt-sheen:#3B5BFF;--rose:#FF6AAE;--ink-night:#F4F2FF;--font-text:"Albert Sans",system-ui,sans-serif;--ease-out:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);} .ds-night{background:var(--cyc-black);padding:2rem;} .ds-btn-cue{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.75rem;padding:.95rem 1.5rem;border:1px solid var(--cobalt-sheen);background:rgba(10,51,255,.14);color:var(--ink-night);font-family:var(--font-text);font-size:.8125rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.2em;text-decoration:none;text-transform:uppercase;transition:background-color .3s var(--ease-out),border-color .3s var(--ease-out),box-shadow .3s var(--ease-out);} .ds-btn-cue svg{transition:transform .3s var(--ease-out);} .ds-btn-cue:hover,.ds-btn-cue:focus-visible{background:var(--cobalt);border-color:var(--cobalt);box-shadow:0 14px 34px -12px rgba(10,51,255,.9);} .ds-btn-cue:hover svg{transform:translateX(4px);} .ds-btn-cue:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--rose);outline-offset:3px;}

components.css: :host{--booth-black:#07070B;--booth-line:rgba(185,182,214,.14);--rose:#FF6AAE;--ink-night:#F4F2FF;--ink-night-soft:#B9B6D6;--font-display:"Big Shoulders Stencil","Arial Narrow",sans-serif;--font-text:"Albert Sans",system-ui,sans-serif;--ease-out:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);} .ds-booth{background:var(--booth-black);padding:2rem;display:flex;gap:.5rem;font-family:var(--font-text);} .ds-fader{--track-h:8rem;flex:0 0 5rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;padding:.5rem .25rem .6rem;background:rgba(5,5,8,.45);border:1px solid transparent;color:var(--ink-night);font:inherit;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .25s var(--ease-out),background-color .25s var(--ease-out);} .ds-fader:hover{border-color:var(--booth-line);background:rgba(5,5,8,.7);} .ds-fader:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--rose);outline-offset:3px;} .ds-fv{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.5rem;font-weight:800;line-height:1;} .ds-track{position:relative;width:6px;height:var(--track-h);background:rgba(185,182,214,.12);} .ds-fill{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(0deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--gel) 35%,transparent),var(--gel));box-shadow:0 0 14px color-mix(in srgb,var(--gel) 70%,transparent);transform:scaleY(var(--level));transform-origin:bottom;transition:transform .5s var(--ease-out);} .ds-cap{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:0;width:2.25rem;height:.75rem;transform:translate(-50%,calc(50% - var(--level) * var(--track-h)));background:#1A1B33;border:1px solid rgba(185,182,214,.35);box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 0 var(--gel),0 6px 12px -4px rgba(0,0,0,.8);transition:transform .5s var(--ease-out);} .ds-fn{color:var(--ink-night-soft);font-size:.6875rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;}

narrative.overview:
Every surface is a seamless stage wall lit through one day: blackout at the top, a low cobalt horizon, rose gathering above it, then dawn rose into white day. Content is placed by light, not by boxes. The public site (Read mode) lets a story stand lit on the horizon, runs the rest of the day as a cue sheet, and does its reading on a white-day sheet; the admin (Operate mode) is the lighting booth for the same stage, where filters are a cue rail and platforms are channels on a fader bank.

Grouping comes from horizon bands and hairline rules. Platform brand colours are lighting gels, never decoration: they colour share controls, chips, faders and chart series, and nothing else. Silhouetted set pieces (authored SVGs cropped to their ink) stand with their feet exactly on the horizon line, reflected blurred in the stage floor below. Motion is cue-like: a share fires a GO cue (gel bloom, counter steps), and the article's fixed stage brightens from night to day as the reader scrolls. Reduced motion parks every state.

The system refuses the cream broadsheet front page, the card grid, and the KPI-tile analytics template.
keyCharacteristics: Vertical night-to-day gradient as the organising ground; cobalt horizon low, rose glow above it.
Stencil caps (Big Shoulders Stencil 800) for headlines, panel labels and counts; Albert Sans for everything read or operated.
Square stage corners on the public site; a 2px booth radius in the admin.
Hairlines, not boxes, on the stage; matte hairlined panels only in the booth.
Platform colours appear only as gels, lifted to a pale stage tint when they would vanish on a dark ground.

rules.name: The Gel Rule
rules.body: Platform brand colour is light on a control, never fill on a surface: an icon tint, a 4px foot strip, a hover border and a coloured under-glow. It never becomes a background block or body text.

rules.name: The Lift-to-Stage Rule
rules.body: Any gel whose relative luminance is below 0.03 (X at #000000) is lifted to #E9E7F5 on dark grounds via `on_stage()` / `stage_color`. On white day the true brand colour is used. Never ship a near-black gel onto a night stage.

rules.name: The Dawn Ramp Rule
rules.body: Big grounds travel black, night, cobalt, violet (#6F4BD9 / #7B54E0), rose-pink (#FF8CC0), dawn, day wash, white, in that order. Never reverse it and never skip cobalt straight to white.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: All numerals are tabular (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` on body). Counts, times and data never jitter when they change.

rules.name: The Stencil-Is-Light Rule
rules.body: Stencil caps are for what is lit: headlines, panel labels and counts. Running text, summaries, form values and table cells are always Albert Sans.

rules.name: The Feet-on-the-Line Rule
rules.body: Set pieces are cropped to their ink and positioned with `bottom` equal to the floor height, so they stand exactly on the horizon line. Never pad a silhouette or float it above the line.

rules.name: The One Share Bar Rule
rules.body: On phones, the fixed share dock parks itself whenever the story's own share bar is on screen. Only one bar is ever visible.

rules.name: The Lit-From-Below Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is soft, negative-spread and offset downward. Cued glows are coloured by their light (cobalt, rose or the gel); the few resting lifts are deep cobalt or black. No hard offset shadows, no mid-grey drop shadows.

dos: **Do** organise every large ground as the dawn ramp: black at the top, cobalt horizon low, rose above it, ending in white day where reading happens.
**Do** pass platform colours through `on_stage()` / `stage_color` before using them on a dark ground.
**Do** group with horizon bands and 1px hairlines (line-night, line-day, booth-line) on the stage.
**Do** set counts, totals and fader values in stencil numerals with tabular figures.
**Do** stand set pieces on the horizon line, cropped to their ink, with the rose drop-shadow halo and a blurred reflection in the floor.
**Do** make cued states read as light: a coloured downward glow, a rising strip, a lit lamp.
donts: **Don't** box content on the public stage; no card grids, no rounded panels.
**Don't** use platform brand colour as a surface fill or as text colour.
**Don't** use hard offset shadows or mid-grey drop shadows; hover and focus glows take the colour of their light.
**Don't** add corner radius to site components, or more than 3px in the booth (lamps excepted).
**Don't** set running text, form values or table data in the stencil face.
**Don't** put a near-black gel on a night ground unlifted.
